result.summary: The surface of gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 shown here is resolve.go and yaml.go. Their init functions only build in-memory lookup tables for YAML scalar resolution and tags, and cache a reflect type. Nothing reaches the network, file system, environment or process execution, and the code matches the upstream library and its purpose.

findings.title: Init functions only populate in-memory lookup tables
findings.detail: init() in resolve.go fills the resolver lookup table and the tag maps. init() in yaml.go caches the reflect type of Unmarshaler. None of these touch the file system, network, environment or other packages.
